context: One adapter per PR after the ADR. Prefer a DB-API adapter (Firebolt already uses the mixin; next is a cloud adapter only if hooks can express its deltas). Run duplicate-check-delta.
description:
BLOCKED on arch-composition-boundary-adr. Do not fold adapters until the ADR names the winning primitive and its home layer.

Incumbents (must not silently merge):
- CursorValidationQueryExecutionMixin (core): logs validation PASS/FAIL; always connection.cursor(); no rollback; no result digest.
- execute_sql_query (platforms): rollback after error; result-digest oracle; pre-created cursor support; QueryValidator without PASS/FAIL logs.

Confirmed duplication: redshift.py:2078-2112 and databricks/adapter.py:1978-2012 are byte-identical validate+log+build blocks. QueryValidator() appears in 16 benchbox files. Firebolt and Presto/Trino already use the mixin.

Per-adapter, enumerate these behaviors BEFORE the fold: query tags, statistics APIs, plan capture, rollback, result digest, cursor ownership, query rewrite, job APIs.

Irreducible stop conditions (stop after the first adapter if any cannot be a hook without behavior change):
- BigQuery in-memory QueryJob plan
- Athena pre-close cursor reads
- Redshift pg_last_query_id() ordering
- Snowflake QUERY_TAG pre/post coupling

Do not add a third mixin. Do not fold all four cloud adapters in one PR.

Stop condition: first adapter folded with enumerated deltas, or a recorded stop because an irreducible behavior cannot be a hook.

anti_patterns.dont: add CursorValidationQueryExecutionMixin AND keep execute_sql_query as a second path for the same adapter
anti_patterns.instead: one primitive per adapter after the ADR
anti_patterns.why: that creates a third observable mix

anti_patterns.dont: fold Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery in one PR
anti_patterns.instead: one adapter, then stop or continue

anti_patterns.dont: start this item before the ADR names a home layer

preserves.behavior: Plan capture and cost resource_usage fields remain populated where they are today
Result bundle validation fields stay schema-compatible
